description: Keltron secures ₹197 crore order for AI-based traffic enforcement systems in Nagpur, positioning as smart traffic solutions leader.
body_lead: The Kerala State Electronics Development Corporation (Keltron), a public sector undertaking, has bagged an order worth ₹197 crore from the Nagpur Corporation following a competitive bid for AI-based traffic enforcement systems to enhance traffic safety across 171 junctions. Industries Minister P. Rajeeve said in a post in X that Keltron’s proven expertise with AI-based traffic enforcement systems, already successful in the State’s Safe Kerala initiative, played a key role in securing this mega project.
